section: One life force common to all men
claim: Ralph Waldo Emerson: "There is one mind common to all individual men. Every man is an inlet to the same and to all of the same."

section: One life force common to all men
claim: Beside the one mind Emerson says is common to all individual men, there is also one fire common to all individual men, one indomitable spirit

section: One life force common to all men
claim: Just as surely as we are part of the one mind Emerson refers to, we are part of one unstoppable life force, one strength

section: One life force common to all men
claim: You are an inlet to the full power of the one unstoppable life force, one strength, common to all men
As you battle resistance to persist through challenges, you do not battle alone: "We battle as one."

section: One life force common to all men
claim: We men are brothers, forever connected by and fueled by the same power, the one unstoppable life force common to all men
Honor yourself and your fellow man by recognizing within yourself the one life force common to all men
To honor yourself and your fellow man, do the work
To honor yourself and your fellow man, look within

section: One life force common to all men
claim: The spirit and strength we men all share flows through you
